title: Create an Approval Log for AI-Assisted Work
readerPromise: Help a small team record the evidence, review and decision behind consequential AI-assisted work.

reel.topic: Keep an AI approval record useful and proportionate
reel.promise: Show the minimum context that helps a reviewer trace a decision.

sections.heading: Record the work and its context
sections.readerQuestion: What should an approval record identify?
sections.purpose: Connect purpose, owner and referenced source material.
keyPoints: Name the task and accountable owner
Reference source material while minimizing sensitive details

sections.heading: Show what was checked
sections.purpose: Capture relevant evidence and unresolved limitations.
keyPoints: Record limits and scale review to impact

sections.heading: Make the decision specific
sections.readerQuestion: How should an approval decision be recorded?
sections.purpose: Separate content approval from authority to act.
keyPoints: Identify the exact version and next action

sections.heading: Keep the record useful and proportionate
sections.readerQuestion: How can the record remain useful over time?
sections.purpose: Explain retention, access and improvement boundaries.
keyPoints: Use recurring corrections to improve the process
